business_summary.text: KSH International is a manufacturer of magnet winding wires, including continuously transposed conductors (CTC) for power transformers, serving over 120 OEM customers with exports to four continents.

call_points.text: FY27 volume growth guided at least 21%, matching FY26, with full-year Supa capacity.
EBITDA per tonne sustainable at ₹65,000-70,000 long term.
Installed capacity 43,445 MT at March 2026; Supa Phase II to take it to ~59,000 MT in FY27.
Green copper backward integration project expected to commence in H2 FY27.
Specialised wires EBITDA per tonne about 3x standard wires; mix shift drives overall margin.
Operating leverage from new capacity expected only after Q4 FY27.
Debt-to-EBITDA improved to 0.39x in FY26 from 1.21x in FY25.

guidance.statement: FY27 volume growth of at least 21%, matching FY26.

timeline.summary: KSH International Limited schedules earnings conference call on May 26, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (IST) to discuss Q4FY26 audited financial results with Mr. Rajesh Hegde, Mr. Amod Joshi, Mr. Dhruv Chopra, and Mr. Nakul Patil.
KSH International released its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 on May 14, 2026, reporting ₹70.11 Cr in unutilised IPO proceeds and minor deployment delays.
KSH International successfully commissioned a 3220 kWp rooftop solar power plant at its Supa Facility on May 18, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,018.34 Cr, net profit ₹34.53 Cr.
KSH International reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,018.34 Cr and FY26 PAT of ₹110.13 Cr, backed by strong volume and export growth.
KSH International Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call on May 26, 2026, discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 results.
KSH International's Q4 FY26 earnings call guided FY27 volume growth of at least 21% and EBITDA per tonne of ₹65,000-70,000, with Supa Phase II capacity on track for FY27.

KSH International Limited schedules earnings conference call on November 05, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (IST) to discuss unaudited Q2-H1/FY27 results with Rajesh Hegde, Hemant Lakhotiya, Amod Joshi, Dhruv Chopra, and Nakul Patil.
Received PGCIL manufacturer approval for CTC, PICC, and BPICC up to 765 kV class from Supa Facility on October 21, 2026.
